The company exhibits severe liquidity issues with a current ratio of 0.68 (well below the healthy threshold of 1.5+), indicating potential difficulty in meeting short-term obligations. While leverage is moderate (debt-to-equity ratio of 0.79) and profitability appears strong (EBIT margin of 48%), the low asset turnover (6.86%) and negative working capital (-$3,015M) suggest operational inefficiency and high short-term financial risk. The Altman Z-score of approximately 1.45 falls in the distress zone (below 1.81), supporting a speculative grade with high default risk, warranting a rating in the CCC range.

DECISION: CCC+
